name: base3system_sysallocview
label: XRM Allocation View
description: Symmetric view of XRM allocations. Each connection from base3system_sysalloc appears bidirectionally — via entry_id and peer_id.

fields.name: entry_id
fields.label: Entry ID
fields.description: ID of the current XRM entry (used for join mapping).

fields.name: peer_id
fields.label: Peer Entry ID
fields.description: ID of the connected entry (the other side of the relationship).
